#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching {
public:
    int m, n;
    vector<vector<int>> g;
    vector<int> pairU, pairV, dis;
    const int inf = INT_MAX;
    const int NIL = 0;

    HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching(int m, int n, vector<vector<int>>& g) {
        this->m = m;
        this->n = n;
        this->g = g;
        pairU.assign(m + 1, NIL);
        pairV.assign(n + 1, NIL);
        dis.assign(m + 1, 0);
    }

    int maximumMatching() {
        fill(pairU.begin(), pairU.end(), NIL);
        fill(pairV.begin(), pairV.end(), NIL);
        int maxMatching = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            for (int u = 1; u <= m; u++) {
                if (pairU[u] == NIL && dfs(u))
                    maxMatching++;
            }
        }
        return maxMatching;
    }

private:
    bool bfs() {
        queue<int> q;
        for (int u = 1; u <= m; u++) {
            if (pairU[u] == NIL) {
                dis[u] = 0;
                q.push(u);
            } else {
                dis[u] = inf;
            }
        }
        dis[NIL] = inf;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            if (dis[u] < dis[NIL]) {
                for (auto v : g[u]) {
                    if (dis[pairV[v]] == inf) {
                        dis[pairV[v]] = dis[u] + 1;
                        q.push(pairV[v]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dis[NIL] != inf;
    }

    bool dfs(int u) {
        if (u != NIL) {
            for (auto v : g[u]) {
                if (dis[pairV[v]] == dis[u] + 1) {
                    if (dfs(pairV[v])) {
                        pairV[v] = u;
                        pairU[u] = v;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
            dis[u] = inf;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    long long ans = 0;

    if (n > 100) {
        int nn = (n - 100) % 6;
        long long nq = (n - 100) / 6;
        ans += nq * 6LL * m;
        n = 100 + nn;
    }

    if (m > 100) {
        int nm = (m - 100) % 6;
        long long mq = (m - 100) / 6;
        ans += mq * 6LL * n;
        m = 100 + nm;
    }

    vector<vector<int>> mat(n + 1, vector<int>(m + 1, 0));

    int u_label = 1;
    int v_label = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                mat[i][j] = u_label++;
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 != 0) {
                mat[i][j] = v_label++;
            }
        }
    }

    int U_size = u_label - 1;
    int V_size = v_label - 1;
    vector<vector<int>> g(U_size + 1);

    auto addEdge = [&](int i, int j, int s, int t) {
        if (s <= 0 || t <= 0 || s > n || t > m) return;
        g[mat[i][j]].push_back(mat[s][t]);
    };

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                addEdge(i, j, i - 3, j);
                addEdge(i, j, i - 2, j - 1);
                addEdge(i, j, i - 2, j + 1);
                addEdge(i, j, i, j - 3);
                addEdge(i, j, i - 1, j - 2);
                addEdge(i, j, i + 1, j - 2);
                addEdge(i, j, i, j + 3);
                addEdge(i, j, i - 1, j + 2);
                addEdge(i, j, i + 1, j + 2);
                addEdge(i, j, i + 3, j);
                addEdge(i, j, i + 2, j - 1);
                addEdge(i, j, i + 2, j + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching bpm(U_size, V_size, g);
    int matching = bpm.maximumMatching();
    ans += 2LL * matching;

    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
